name: ARX-199i
summary: Versatile semi-automatic clinical chemistry analyzer for enzymes, substrates, therapeutic drugs, electrolytes and turbidimetry. Peltier-controlled 18 µL flow cell, automatic filter wheel and built-in thermal printer, plus a dry bath incubator that sets the 199i apart from the standard ARX-199.

specs.label: Methods
specs.value: Absorbance, end point with standard or factor, kinetic, fixed time, differential, multipoint (up to 10 standards)

specs.label: Applications
specs.value: Enzymes, substrates, therapeutic drugs, electrolytes, turbidimetry

specs.label: Dry bath incubator
specs.value: 15 positions for 13 mm tubes, 4 positions for 10 mm tubes (ARX-199i only)

specs.label: Aspiration
specs.value: Continuous-flow bi-directional peristaltic pump, programmable 200 µL – 1.0 mL

specs.label: Result memory
specs.value: 1,000 results with patient ID (128 KB EEPROM)

specs.label: Quality control
specs.value: 2 levels per test (normal and abnormal), last 30 QC results stored

specs.label: Display
specs.value: Graphic LCD, 240 × 64 px, blue LED backlight

specs.label: Built-in printer
specs.value: Thermal graphic, 50 mm/s, 384 dots/line, 57 mm paper

features: Edit patient ID, name (12 characters) and factor
Online kinetic graph with OD display, graph editing and result estimation
Multipoint calibration with up to 10 standards
Built-in dry bath incubator with 19 tube positions
Stores 1,000 test results with patient ID
Printouts include laboratory and doctor names
